suggested_requirements.text: The Web server shall replicate content on-demand from the origin server.
The Web server shall initiate a request to trigger peering in the event of a Web hotspot.
The Web services host shall ensure the delivery of content to end-users based on negotiated policies.
The SLA-allocator shall perform provisioning and reservation of Web server resources to satisfy SLAs.
The Mediator shall generate service requirements as the basis for negotiated relationships.
The Mediator shall pass service requirements to the Peering Agent.
The Mediator shall control the redirection of Web traffic to peering CDNs.
The Service Registry shall store resource and service information for each CDN.
The Service Registry shall supply local resource information to the mediator during traffic surges.
The Policy Repository shall provide rules to the mediator to administer and control access to resources.
The Peering Agent shall exchange policy, resource information, and service requirements with external Peering Agents.
The system shall perform content replication using a cooperative pull-based approach.
The system shall perform load distribution by measuring and disseminating load information using a hierarchical approach.
The system shall perform request assignment and redirection via DNS and CDN gateway redirection.
The system shall use a cryptographically secure auction-based framework for content replication.
The system shall decrease Web access cost and reduce latency to improve content delivery performance.
The system shall be implemented using a modular stack on top of standard application layers and protocols.
The system shall use TCP/IP as the transport protocol for communication between software components.
